blockers.workItem: C1-SCOPE-01/A1 — Day-1 scope matrix: classify every EOS family with cited evidence
blockers.question: S-1 — Does Taylor operate a CRM pipeline (Opportunity, families 4/4b) and sell under Sales Agreements (family 5) from Day 1, or does the Day-1 commercial flow begin at Sales Order?
blockers.whyAutomationCannotDecide: The families are built and partly Owner-accepted, so this is not a readiness question. It is a fact about how Taylor actually sells, which is not in the repository.
blockers.blockingScope: Classification of families 4, 4b and 5, and therefore the C1-PRODUCT-01 Day-1 workflow remainder.
blockers.remainingExecutableWork: All other family classifications are proposed and the acceptance evidence index can proceed.

blockers.workItem: C1-SCOPE-01/A1 — Day-1 scope matrix: classify every EOS family with cited evidence
blockers.question: S-2 — Is Reporting a Day-1 commitment, a pilot, or post-Day-1 for Customer 1?
blockers.whyAutomationCannotDecide: PRs #1768/#1779 make production adoption representable in configuration but explicitly not live production evidence. Whether Taylor is promised Reporting on Day 1 is a commercial/contractual boundary, not a technical readiness state.

blockers.workItem: A-SCOPE-MATRIX-1 — Day-1 scope matrix: proposed classification for every EOS family (C1-SCOPE-01 seeded objective 1)
blockers.question: Grant the lane worker permission to run git add and git commit in this worktree, or have the harness commit the worktree changes on the lane's behalf.
blockers.whyAutomationCannotDecide: Every git write command in this environment returns 'requires manual approval'. The run is unattended and the lane may not authorize its own commands, so no approval path exists from inside the work item.
blockers.blockingScope: Only the commit boundary. All four files are written and internally consistent in the worktree.
blockers.remainingExecutableWork: None for this item; the content is finished. Subsequent Lane A items are equally blocked at their commit boundary until this is resolved.

blockers.workItem: A-SCOPE-MATRIX-1 — Day-1 scope matrix (seeded objective 1) for C1-SCOPE-01
blockers.question: For C1-SCOPE-01's close condition, does 'every EOS family' mean the North Star migration ledger's family rows, the broader business capability register, or the union of both?
blockers.whyAutomationCannotDecide: The two registers are differently shaped (page families vs capabilities) and the gate's own wording does not name one. Picking the narrower register would let the gate close on a census that omits real scope; picking the broader one changes what Taylor is being asked to accept. That is a Verenward/Taylor scope-authority decision.
blockers.blockingScope: Whether the matrix is complete enough to be put to Taylor for acceptance, and therefore C1-SCOPE-01 closure.
blockers.remainingExecutableWork: The matrix covers the family register and names the four largest surfaces outside it; per-family gate reconciliation for C1-PRODUCT-01 can proceed against the DAY_1 proposals regardless of the answer.
